ticket: PL-15 — Repo restructure: separate the marketing site from the monorepo root
goal: Make the repository root read as a monorepo root rather than as a Vite marketing site with a monorepo grafted around it: move the marketing site into its own apps/site/ workspace, give every loose top-level directory a home, commit the orphaned audit artifacts, and update every path that CI, the deploy, the docs, or a test pins — with zero change to what the deployed site serves.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The marketing site's sources live under apps/site/ and nowhere else: `git ls-files index.html src public vite.config.ts` returns nothing, and apps/site/index.html, apps/site/vite.config.ts, apps/site/src/main.tsx, apps/site/src/App.tsx, apps/site/src/config.ts, apps/site/public/_redirects, apps/site/public/og.png, apps/site/public/favicon.svg, and apps/site/public/media/ all exist and are tracked. Every moved file's contents are byte-identical to its pre-move contents except apps/site/vite.config.ts and apps/site/src/landing/heroTreeData.ts.

apps/site/package.json exists, is named @sayre/site, and matches the shape in Interfaces (including every version spec carried over verbatim). The root package.json is named `sayre`, has no `dependencies` key, includes `apps/*` in `workspaces`, and retains every check:*/test:*/generate:*/ledger:*/stamp/typecheck:*/*:workspaces/workspace-pack/test:product-workspace-ux script verbatim, plus dev/build/preview as delegating aliases.
`npm ci` at the repo root exits 0 against the committed package-lock.json (i.e. the lockfile was regenerated in this change, not left stale).

`npm run build` at the repo root exits 0 and produces, at repo-root dist/: index.html, assets/ (one .js + one .css), _redirects, og.png, favicon.svg, and media/ with all 8 files. The set of emitted paths is the same set as a pre-change build.
`npx tsc --noEmit` at the repo root exits 0, and the root tsconfig.json's `include` is ["apps/site/src"] (so the command is not vacuously passing over an empty file set).
.github/workflows/ci.yml's `node` job contains a `site — build` step running `npm run build --workspace @sayre/site`, placed after the root install step.

scripts/ contains no marketing-site script: scripts/og.mjs, scripts/render-anime-hero.mjs, scripts/smoke.mjs, scripts/test-waitlist.mjs, scripts/export-tree.mjs, and scripts/anime-hero-render/ do not exist, and their apps/site/scripts/ counterparts do. Every scripts/*.test.mjs file and every SDD control-plane .mjs remains at scripts/ (unmoved), and scripts/tsconfig.json's compilerOptions and include array are unchanged.

No directory at the repo root has a name containing a space, and `Design System/`, `Documents/`, and `design/` no longer exist. docs/design-system/ holds all 6 former `Design System/` files; docs/product/ holds PRD-V1.pdf and SAYRE_FRONTEND_SPEC.md; apps/site/design/handoffs/anime-hero-animation/ holds the former design/ tree.

`git ls-files docs/audits` lists docs/audits/architecture-assessment-2026-07.md, docs/audits/deep-audit-2026-07-31.md, and 18 files under docs/audits/deep-audit-2026-07-31/; none of them remain at their former docs/ locations, and their contents are byte-identical to the untracked originals.

edgeCases.text: package-lock.json not regenerated after the manifests are split: `npm ci` fails with "lock file does not satisfy package.json". The single most likely way this change turns CI red on every job at once.

The Cloudflare Pages dashboard's build command is not `npm run build` (e.g. a literal `vite build`, or a --prefix/--filter form), or its output directory is not `dist`, or its root directory is not `/`. The shim then does not cover it and the site build breaks on merge. AC-16 exists to catch this before merge, not after.
A live Vercel project exists with Root Directory `/`. vercel.json must stay at the repo root (Vercel reads it from the configured root directory), which is why this ticket does not move it.
`git mv` on a directory whose name contains a space ("Design System") — the path must be quoted; an unquoted invocation silently moves the wrong thing or errors.

Case-insensitive filesystem (this checkout is Windows). None of the moves is a case-only rename, but Documents/ → docs/product/ involves an existing docs/ directory whose name differs only in case at the first letter — verify with `git ls-files docs Documents` after the move that no path was silently merged or lost.

dist/ already exists at the repo root with stale content from a previous build. Vite refuses to empty an outDir outside its project root unless emptyOutDir: true is set explicitly; without it the build either warns and leaves stale files or fails. With it, confirm the emitted set is complete rather than a merge of old and new.

A moved script's relative path resolving to a different but existing location instead of failing loudly (e.g. scripts/.fontcache now meaning apps/site/scripts/.fontcache). Verify by execution or by reading each resolved path, not by assuming.

Moving any scripts/*.test.mjs file out of scripts/ would break scripts/sdd-completeness.test.mjs's non-recursive readdirSync enumeration and its `scripts/([\w.-]+\.test\.mjs)` package.json-value regex (the character class cannot cross a /). This ticket moves none of them; confirm that holds.

.claude/settings.json's PreToolUse hook runs the cwd-relative command `node scripts/guard-checker-readonly.mjs`. That script does not move; if it ever did, the review/security-checker/pr-review read-only guard would silently stop enforcing (a hook that fails to load exits 1, and only exit 2 blocks).

A pre-existing red-listed test's content hash changes without being declared, which review's red-test integrity check treats as a Critical. Exactly one such file changes here (scripts/dependency-baseline.test.mjs); it must be declared in .pipeline/changes.json.

check:secret-access runs before `npm ci` and scans every tracked .ts/.tsx/.js/.jsx/.mjs/.cjs/.py file from `git ls-files`, excluding path segments named node_modules|.venv|venv|__pycache__|dist|build|coverage|generated|vendor. Moved files stay in scope (none lands under an excluded segment), and its ALLOWLIST contains no moved path — so the gate's verdict must be unchanged. Confirm rather than assume: this step runs first in CI.

.sdd/ledger/**, .sdd/stages/CHANGELOG.md, and .pipeline-backup-*/ contain many references to the old paths. These are historical records of past runs and must not be rewritten by the reference sweep; a find-and-replace there would corrupt a content-hashed ledger entry and fail test:sdd-completeness's pinned-hash assertions.

.sdd/bounds.yml's frontend lane allows apps/web/** and docs/**. apps/site/** is in no fenced lane, exactly as root src/** is today — leaving it alone preserves the existing fence rather than silently widening it. A deliberate non-change (D9).

Turbo caching: @sayre/site's build writes outside its own package directory, so the root turbo.json's outputs: ["dist/**", ".next/**"] would record an empty output set and could report a cache hit for a build that produced nothing. apps/site/turbo.json disables the cache for that one task.

`npm run workspace-pack` (vite-node packages/workspace-packs/src/cli-entry.ts) has no declared vite-node/vite dependency anywhere; it resolves today via hoisting. Removing vite from the root devDeps must not break it (vitest still brings vite and vite-node transitively). Verify the command still starts.
public/_redirects carries both the SPA fallback and the /demo → / redirect. If it fails to reach dist/_redirects, /privacy 404s on Cloudflare Pages — a break that the build exiting 0 will not reveal.

public/og.png, public/favicon.svg, and public/media/* are committed static binaries, not build products (npm run og / npm run hero:render regenerate them on demand). They must be moved, never regenerated — a regenerated binary is an unreviewable diff.

Leftover empty directories after the moves (src/, public/, Design System/, Documents/, Documents/PRD/, Documents/Spec/, design/, scripts/anime-hero-render/). Git does not track empty directories, so they will not show in a diff but will still be on disk and in a file listing — the exact complaint this ticket exists to answer.

apps/web/package.json's description ("Distinct from the root Vite marketing site") becomes false the moment the site moves. Small, but it is the kind of stale claim that teaches the next reader to distrust every other description in the repo.

docs/deep-audit-2026-07-31.md is an index over the 18 files in docs/deep-audit-2026-07-31/. Moving both under docs/audits/ preserves their relative positions, so intra-audit links should survive — verify at least the index's links rather than assuming.

A broadened .gitignore pattern (**/.tmp/, **/.shots/, **/.fontcache/) accidentally matching an existing tracked path. Confirm `git status --porcelain` reports no newly ignored tracked file, and that `git check-ignore` on a representative tracked path in each workspace exits 1.

Root script semantics drift: `npm run dev` must still start the marketing site on :5173 and `npm run build` must still build the site, because both names are load-bearing outside this repo (deploy) and in muscle memory. Changing dev to mean "turbo across workspaces" would be a defensible design and is explicitly not done here.

apps/site joins the apps/* workspace glob, so `turbo run lint|typecheck|test` across workspaces now includes it. @sayre/site declares no lint or test script; turbo skips missing tasks rather than failing, but confirm `npm run test:workspaces` and `npm run lint:workspaces` still exit 0.

engines: { "node": ">=20 <21" } on @sayre/site under a Node runtime outside that range (Cloudflare Pages' default build image, a contributor on Node 22) produces an EBADENGINE warning — harmless unless engine-strict is set, but note it if the Pages build log shows it.
